run_swav_training: run distributed SwAV self-supervised training on ImageNet with a ResNet50 backbone and multiple crops
run_distributed_training: run multi-GPU distributed training with synchronized batch norm and mixed precision for SwAV
run_sinkhorn_algorithm: run the distributed Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm to compute uniform cluster assignments for prototypes
run_checkpoint_resume: run SwAV training resuming from a saved checkpoint with optimizer and AMP state restored
run_queue_augmentation: run SwAV training with a feature queue that starts after a specified epoch for better assignments
